replacements.Dos fases con perfiles de consumo radica: Two phases with radically different consumption profiles
replacements.Entrenar un modelo ocurre una vez y conc: Training a model happens once and concentrates energy use over weeks. Serving the model happens billions of times per day. Cumulative inference consumption can exceed training consumption as adoption grows.
replacements.consumo estimado del entrenamiento inici: estimated consumption of the initial GPT-4 training run — equivalent to the annual electricity use of several thousand homes
replacements.Se ejecuta una vez por versión (semanas: Runs once per version (weeks or months of intensive compute)
replacements.Miles de aceleradores en paralelo en un: Thousands of accelerators running in parallel in one data center
replacements.Se concentra donde la electricidad es má: Concentrated where electricity is cheaper: renewables and regions with overnight surplus
replacements.por consulta a un LLM — ×10 frente a una: per LLM query — ×10 versus a web search (0.3 Wh); up to ×40 per minute of generated video
replacements.Miles de millones de consultas diarias e: Billions of daily queries in continuous production
replacements.El consumo acumulado puede superar al en: Cumulative consumption can exceed training consumption under mass adoption
replacements.Se despliega cerca de los usuarios: la l: Deployed close to users: low latency requires geographic proximity
